#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

ll modpow(ll b, ll e) {
    ll ans = 1;
    for (; e; e /= 2) {
        if (e % 2 == 1) ans = ans * b % MOD;
        b = b * b % MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

class DSU {
    vector<int> parent, sz;
public:
    int components;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n), sz(n, 1), components(n) {
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int x) {
        int root = x;
        while (parent[root] != root) root = parent[root];
        while (parent[x] != x) {
            int nxt = parent[x];
            parent[x] = root;
            x = nxt;
        }
        return root;
    }
    void unite(int a, int b) {
        a = find(a);
        b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return;
        if (sz[a] < sz[b]) swap(a, b);
        parent[b] = a;
        sz[a] += sz[b];
        --components;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    vector<unsigned char> seen(p, 0);
    DSU dsu((int)p);

    for (ll start = 0; start < p; ++start) {
        ll cur = start;
        while (!seen[cur]) {
            seen[cur] = 1;
            dsu.unite((int)start, (int)cur);
            cur = cur * k % p;
        }
    }

    ll exponent = dsu.components;
    if (k != 1) --exponent;
    cout << modpow(p, exponent) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
